step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture shows Clumio's backup and metadata analysis solution for AWS workloads. On the left, in the customer's account, there is CloudFormation (CFT), IAM, data sources grouped together (EBS, RDS, DynamoDB), and EventBridge. On the right, in Clumio's managed AWS account, there are KMS, IAM Role, S3 (for backup data), SQS, two Lambda functions, Metadata Engine, and a second S3 bucket (for metadata). We decompose the grouped data sources (EBS, RDS, DynamoDB) into individual nodes as required by Rule 4. Arrows connect CFT to KMS and IAM Role; EventBridge to SQS; SQS to bottom Lambda; bottom Lambda to Metadata Engine and bottom S3; data sources (EBS, RDS, DynamoDB) to middle S3; and top Lambda to IAM Role and middle S3.
